import json
def state_sig():
    a = current_frame.ascii
    # green core pos, red state, blue state
    g = 'TL' if 'NN' in a.split('\n')[38][8:14] else 'TR' if 'NN' in a.split('\n')[38][11:15] else ('BL' if 'NN' in a.split('\n')[40][8:14] else 'BR')
    red = 'B' if a.split('\n')[24][18:22]=='RRRR' else 'A'
    blue = '1' if a.split('\n')[20][18:22] in ('bcb','cbc') else '0'
    return (red, blue, g)
def check(tag):
    r = last_action_result
    interesting = {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward','board_changed')}
    print(tag, state_sig(), interesting)
    return r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('game_over')
seq = [
    ('UP','B1-TR'), ('LEFT','B1-TL'), ('DOWN','B1-BL'),
    ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}],'B0-BL'),
    ('RIGHT','B0-BR'), ('UP','B0-TR'), ('LEFT','B0-TL'),
    ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}],'A0-TL'),
    ('DOWN','A0-BL'), ('RIGHT','A0-BR'), ('UP','A0-TR'),
    ([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}],'A1-TR'),
    ('DOWN','A1-BR'), ('LEFT','A1-BL'), ('UP','A1-TL'),
]
for act, tag in seq:
    action([act] if isinstance(act,str) else act)
    if check(tag):
        print("TERMINAL at", tag); break
else:
    print("no terminal in 16 combos")

</function>
